verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runner with its own chat interface, so connecting to cloud providers is a fair question for it. The evidence points the other way: it is documented as running models entirely on-device with "No cloud", and its server sandbox blocks outbound connections. Nothing shows cloud-provider connectivity within its interface.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
